start: Gym tab, My gym part, linked to a gym whose server has 0056, online

steps.action: Open the Gym tab and scroll the My gym part to the card
user_sees: Card titled 'Bring a friend'
'Send a friend a link to your gym. They leave their number, and the gym calls them.'
'When a friend joins, your gym can add 7 free days to your plan.' (only when the gym gives free days)
'Friends who joined: 0'
must_not: A free-days line when the gym gives no free days

steps.action: Tap 'Invite a friend'
user_sees: The phone's share menu
must_not: The app opens a screen of its own instead of the share menu
Nothing happens with no word

steps.action: Pick WhatsApp and send to a friend
user_sees: Message 'Come and train with me at <gym>! Leave your name and number on this page, and the gym will call you: https://app.mettleup.fit/f/<8-letter code>' (join.mettleup.fit once the Worker says so)
must_not: Another member's code in the link
'my gym' in place of the gym's real name when the name is known

steps.action: The friend opens the link, leaves a number; the desk later makes them a member
user_sees: Nothing new on the phone yet
must_not: The friend's name or number shown to the member

steps.action: Come back to the Gym tab later and pull to refresh
user_sees: 'Friends who joined: 1'
must_not: The count staying at 0 after the gym marked the friend joined
A count that includes friends who only left a number

steps.action: Pull down on the Gym tab to refresh

steps.action: Switch to another tab and back to Gym
user_sees: 'Friends who joined: 1' still
must_not: The count going back to 0
